NORMALIZE_LINEAGE_BINDING.forbidden: Parsing CURRENT in recorded string into current proof or collapsing EXECUTION into REQUEST
NORMALIZE_LINEAGE_BINDING.input: pinned plan_action, manifest, accepted BR-C1 binding, provenance
steps: retain typed runtime/G4/profile/subject pins; mark semantics RECORDED_NOT_CURRENT_PROOF

NORMALIZE_SCOPE_BINDING.forbidden: Replacing definition scope with operational target scope without a separate governing rule
NORMALIZE_SCOPE_BINDING.input: pinned plan_action, manifest, accepted BR-C1 binding, provenance
steps: retain manifest source_scope/target_scope and original definition scope in provenance

common_guards: source/manifest binding accepted and not stale
manifest.current_plan.raw_sha256 equals exact plan content hash
unique ActionId selector resolves exact source record
scope/lineage and envelope in candidate equal source-derived values

cross_category_predicates.expression: definition scope = selected source.scope AND target/source scope = manifest subject pins; values need not equal each other
recorded lineage = joined manifest recorded lineage AND manifest plan pin = definition source pin
effect class = governing source effect; production effects never become NON_EFFECTING by result normalization
no root/slot transition may be justified by PASS alone; positive transitions require separately bound proof predicates
knowledge source currentness and required type do not imply producer completion; outcome must remain recorded
unknown result/authority/evidence rule prevents complete construction, even when all literal domains pass

identity_rules: Use preceding ActionIR canonical/domain-separated identities only after complete construction. Null otherwise. Sort maps/set references; preserve execution order.

partial_rule.when: source explicitly contains empty knowledge_requirements list
